searchText: <@456226577798135808> Can you go into details how "regenisis every block" differs from full stateless Ethereum? Danny may know as well, but I don't know who they are here on Discord. 😬 <@!301186049323958275> I think there will be no difference in terms of `lim(Regensis){reset_time->1} == stateless eth` 🙂 that also makes me think that if we apply the "Prepaid tx witness refinement" to Stateless Ethereum, we can remove the gas repricing need What is the prepaid transaction witness refinement? also I think we may be able to make the change of semantics less harsh than I first proposed You mean the thing where transaction sender just includes excess gas and lets the miner figure out the actual witness data (deterministically)? Prepaid tx witness refinement is this: Instead of tx sender paying for witness AND providing it (by including witness into the signed data), tx sender simply prepays for a witness of certain max size. And then the miner, using deterministic algo, fills the witness up > You mean the thing where transaction sender just includes excess gas and lets the miner figure out the actual witness data (deterministically)? <@!301186049323958275> Yes, that That's a good idea, it's just important to realize that different services need to be priced differently... I feel like there is a sweet spot in how many things get priced together, something like EOS obviously went to far in one direction, but Ethereum (the protocol, not including dapps) went too far the other way.
